content:
On Jun 25, 2026, significant progress was made on Kona SP1 enhancements, including refactoring for improved testability and bug fixes for BlobStore soundness. Critical updates to `op-devstack` and superchain configuration were also implemented, alongside a streamlined build process. The day also saw the closure of several issues related to Kona host and `eth_getProof` usage, confirming their non-problematic nature under current configurations.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Kona SP1 Enhancements and Bug Fixes
*   Refactored the Kona SP1 range program to improve native testability and reduce execution costs for coverage cases in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21554](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21554).
*   Implemented a bug fix to ensure BlobStore's soundness is self-contained by adding local asserts for invariants in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21561](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21561).
*   Closed the issue regarding BlobStore soundness in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21490](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21490).

### Infrastructure and Configuration Improvements
*   `op-devstack` now supports controlled lifecycle management, allowing external callers to start and stop services with error-returning semantics in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21286](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21286).
*   Ensured `op-node` correctly loads `keep_karst_upgrade_gas` from the superchain registry for networks like op-sepolia and op-mainnet in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21566](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21566).
*   Streamlined the build process by removing standalone `cannon` and `cannon-builder` image entries in [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21556](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21556).

### Kona Host and `eth_getProof` Clarifications
*   Closed the investigation of `eth_getProof` usage in `kona-host`, confirming it's not an issue as long as `op-reth` with `proofs-history` is enabled in [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#21510](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21510) and [ethereum-optimism/optimism#21510](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21510).
*   Closed the issue concerning the replacement of the rollup config hash in `kona-sp1`, as the change is no longer relevant due to input commitment design updates in [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#18493](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18493) and [ethereum-optimism/optimism#18493](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18493).
